title: AI demand and memory costs drove a 92% second-quarter data center capex increase
key_facts: Dell'Oro Group says data center capex accelerated sharply in Q2 2026; the headline gives 92%.
Baron Fung of Dell'Oro says spending was concentrated in Nvidia Blackwell Ultra and hyperscaler custom accelerators.
Agentic AI created extra demand for general-purpose compute, storage and networking.
Higher memory and storage prices raised average server selling prices.
Supermicro and Lenovo closely followed the leaders; white-box server revenue hit a record, per Dell'Oro.
Neocloud providers and AI model builders were the fastest-growing customer segments.
quote_evidence: Higher memory and storage prices significantly increased average server selling prices and drove additional capex.
Neocloud and AI Model Builder saw a major uptick during the second quarter.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows AI spending broadening beyond the biggest cloud companies.
notes: Article body contains no overall dollar figure; the 92% is in the headline only.
